messages:
maria_oncall: Quick broadcast — scheduling a multi-phase edge cache sweep + routing housekeeping TOMORROW 02:00-05:00 UTC. This is a controlled operation to clear stale KV prefixes and rebalance hot-shards. Expect short p99 spikes (60–180s) in affected regions during each phase.

alex_sre: Got it. Which regions are in the first phase? Any change to the routing/fallback policy?

maria_oncall: Phase 1 = us-west-1 + edge-pop west-eu (02:00–02:45 UTC). Phase 2 = us-east-1 + central-eu (03:00–03:45). Phase 3 = asia regions (04:00–05:00). No functional change to fallback — we will route to warm-standby model variants if latency > 2x baseline.

kevin_infra: Note: we'll also be toggling the per-route concurrency cap for low-priority buckets during each sweep to force cache misses and validate cache-repopulation. That may increase CPU on serving nodes for ~2 mins after each toggle.

carla_pm: Do we need a customer-facing notice? Support needs a blurb they can paste.

maria_oncall: Yes — drafted notice will go to #support later today. Short blurb: "Planned maintenance may cause brief increases in request latency for some routes between 02:00–05:00 UTC. Paid tiers unaffected by SLO relaxation. Reach support if you see persistent errors."

dave_eng: What's the SLO change exactly? I want to update my alert dashboards.

kevin_infra: Temporary SLO adjustment: for the non-paid SLO tier only, p99 latency target relaxes from 250ms -> 500ms for the window per-region. Paid/enterprise tiers remain at current targets and are routed to dedicated pools. This is limited to the maintenance window and automatically reverts.

alex_sre: Add abort criteria: if error-rate > 0.5% sustained > 5m, rollback and pause sweep. Also if region-originated backend saturations > 80% CPU for >3m.

maria_oncall: Agreed. Abort checklist pushed to the runbook. Runbook snippet: ```
# Abort criteria quick checks
1) SLA error-rate > 0.5% for 5m
2) P99 > 2x baseline for >10m and no KV-pop progress
3) GPU/CPU node saturation >80% for >3m
# Commands
kubectl -n serving rollout pause deploy/edge-router
kubectl -n serving tag config edge-cache=hot
```

srebot: scheduled: maintenance-ticket-#4821 created by maria_oncall for 2024-07-24T02:00Z -> 2024-07-24T05:00Z

ops_alerts: notice: Pager duty rotations updated — oncall swap at 01:45 UTC. Paging policy: primary oncall -> fallback -> eng-sre-rotations.

carla_pm: Support blurb approved. I'll send to #support and paste in the status page draft.

dave_eng: Will the synthetic load test at 03:30 be noisy for our metrics? Want to mark it in dashboards as synthetic.

maria_oncall: Synthetic load: 03:30–03:45 UTC targeting non-paid routes, low amplitude (rps ~10% of baseline) to validate fallback. We will emit metrics tag synthetic=true. Dashboards will show synthetic overlays; please ignore for regression alarms during that window.

alex_sre: I'll be on the bridge. @kevin_infra can you handle rollout and be ready to abort?

kevin_infra: Yep, I'll be standing by from 01:30 UTC. I'll also push a quick canary to edge-pop west before Phase 1 to sanity-check kernel/driver loads.

maria_oncall: TL;DR actions: 1) Eng oncall on bridge 01:45–05:15, 2) Support blurb posted + status page, 3) Dashboards tagged synthetic, 4) Abort criteria in runbook, 5) Paid tiers unchanged. Any objections?

carla_pm: No objections from PM side. Thanks for the heads up. :thumbsup:

dave_eng: No objections. Will mute non-critical alerts for the window.

alex_sre: On bridge. Will update thread with post-mortem once complete.

maria_oncall: Thanks team. Post-ops summary expected within 24h. If anything urgent before the window, ping me directly. :rotating_light:
